Title: Used password reset link works a second time
Summary: After a reset link is used to set a new password, the same link opens the reset form again within its validity window and accepts a second password change
Expected: Reset links are single use; a used link is dead

Title: Double booking of the same slot from two sessions
Summary: Two sessions confirm the same open slot within seconds and both receive a success
Expected: One booking exists; the second confirmation fails with a clear message
Actual: Two bookings exist for one slot; the availability check and the booking write are not atomic
